harvests.shape: role-permission table (role, doctype, permission type, permlevel)
harvests.upstreamPath: frappe/erpnext — the DocType permission model (role + permission type + permlevel)
harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/auth/catalog/roles.json and roles.RoleMap: the same table shape, with each grant re-expressed as an identity/rbac resource:action string and validated against that contract rather than against a local permission language

harvests.shape: field-level permissions (a permlevel that withholds a field from a role)
harvests.builtInstead: integrations/erp/auth/policies.py and catalog/field-policies.json, where a rule either enforces (withholds read or write) or advises, and its effect must be a word from guardrails/policy's DecisionLevel vocabulary
